name: Residual Necessity Reality Benchmark
description: A multi-track evaluation contract for determining whether current, externally grounded evidence still justifies a proposed state transition. The benchmark composes pinned external sources without redistributing them: AgentAbstain for paired runtime necessity, P3 for real partial-fix histories, and SafeAct for action-support versus necessity-boundary interoperability. Tracks remain semantically separate and are not collapsed into one aggregate leaderboard score.
